<!-- pr-reviewer: 6939377466d0cd795be353096a14a80eb3461abc -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Review of head `6939377`, trial-merged with upstream/main `6898b02` (clean merge, no conflicts). Built and tested locally (Linux).

## Scope

- Test layout only. The PR moves 18 `crates/app/tests/turning_*.rs` files into `crates/app/tests/turning/` and loads them from `turning.rs` with `#[path]`.
- No production code changes. No posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation or geometry changes. This is not a safety-tier review, so no mutations are necessary.
- No process files, no `scripts/`, no `.github/`, no `build.rs`, no dependency changes. No UI changes, so no screenshots are necessary.
- No `testdata/`, golden, `*.nc`, `*.cl` or catalog file changes.

## What looks good

- The renames are 99-100 % similar. The only edits are `mod common;` to `use crate::common;` (or removed where not used) and two `include_str!` paths with one more `../`.
- The test set is the same. On upstream/main, the 19 files have 115 `#[test]` items (`git grep -c '#\[test\]'`). The folded binary lists 115 tests: 6 at the root and 109 in the `turning_<name>::` submodules.
- Upstream/main has no new flat `turning_*.rs` file since the PR base. The trial-merge tree has no file left behind.
- Temp files: each submodule writes a path with its own prefix and the process id. I found no `set_var`, `set_current_dir` or other shared process state.
- `xtask` joins the Gate maps of all sources of a suite (`xtask/src/quick.rs:205`, `gate_maps`). The quick plan selects `app:turning` for this diff.
- No `xtask`, script or workflow file names an old binary (`turning_bore` etc.). The other matches are module names in `crates/app/src/operation/` and comments.
- `turning.rs` is 383 lines (under 400). Some submodules are over 400 lines (`blade.rs` 604, `contour.rs` 513, `thread.rs` 451), but they had that length before the move.
- `docs/decisions/3190-fold-turning-suite.md` records the choice, the readings and what was dropped. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Refs #3190` (partial work, the issue stays open).

## Results (merged with main, locally)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (plan: `app:turning` whole suite) | ok, 1 step, 0 failed (277 s, cold build) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test turning -- --list` | 115 tests (equal to the 115 `#[test]` items before) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Heavy lane `app heavy: turning`: `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test turning -- --ignored` | ok, 0 tests run, 115 filtered out (the suite has no ignored tests) |

Extra suites run: none. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the importer code.

Mutations: not run. The PR changes no production code (not safety tier).

Goldens moved: none, and the body says so.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md:51` and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md:57` link to `../crates/app/tests/turning_profile.rs`. After this PR that file is `../crates/app/tests/turning/profile.rs`, so the two links are dead. Suggested fix: change the path in the two links. (The anchor `turning.rs#L70` on line 57 was already stale before this PR: `bar_mesh` is at line 113 now.) A follow-up at `P7` is sufficient if the author does not fix it here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
